segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The ground support plan for that stope had been signed off about four months earlier... We let day shift go in and start drilling as scheduled.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant defaults to the unrevised support plan despite above-baseline microseismic events and available inspection alternatives.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: The model came back with a 2.3... Stope 9 was just the one that was fresh in my head... I authorized the afternoon blast clearance.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats a precise model rating as settled despite a known blind spot and relies on one vivid prior event instead of broader comparison.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: I leaned toward the crew's read... The inspector's note got filed... because the Stope 9 comparison made the pattern seem like something we already understood.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant treats similarity to one prior crack pattern as validating and selectively transmits reassuring reports while sidelining dissent.

segments.speaker: Participant
segments.raw_interview_anchor: That rock fall didn't worry me much... it read to me as consistent with... minor settling... Twenty years gives you a feel for these things... I authorized the blast.
segments.ground_truth_rationale: The participant interprets a minor rock fall as consistent with stability and expresses high confidence despite sensor lag and unresolved warning signs.

overall_evaluation_summary.segment_level_primary_result: At the recommended high_and_moderate threshold, 2 of 4 positive decision-episode segments are detected (hit rate 0.5000; F1 0.6667).

overall_evaluation_summary.mechanism_first_result: At high_and_moderate, mechanism-first matching recovers the numerically grounded iv_01 mechanism: 3 true positives, 4 false negatives, and 0 false positives yield precision 1.0000, recall 0.4286, and F1 0.6000.
overall_evaluation_summary.candidate_tier_value_assessment: The status-quo candidate is a useful abstention that becomes a correct fourth-threshold detection; the plan-continuation candidate is unsupported and becomes a false positive.
main_failure_modes: Missed the second illusion-of-validity occurrence based on case-pattern coherence.
Missed the second confirmation-bias occurrence based on interpreting the rock fall as confirming stability.
Used anchoring bias as the label for the numeric-model precision mechanism, lowering strict-label performance.
Assigned overconfidence only low confidence, so it is missed at the recommended high_and_moderate threshold.
main_strengths: Correctly identified availability through reliance on the freshest Stope 9 memory.
Correctly identified selective confirmation-bias reporting at DP3.
Quoted evidence is valid and localized; no fabricated quotations were found.
Mechanism-first adjudication shows the anchoring label was a taxonomy error rather than a completely missed mechanism.
overall_evaluation_summary.benchmark_interpretation: This run is conservative and evidence-faithful, but underdetects the hidden ontology at the instance level. Its strongest result is mechanism-level detection of 3 of 7 instances at the recommended threshold, while strict label-plus-mechanism matching detects 2 of 7. Candidate handling is valuable for status quo but introduces one unsupported fourth-threshold false positive.
